name: 993 left turbo heat shield cover, F0 IN625 concept
description: Independent concept of an open shell with integrated bosses for screening an LPBF remanufacture in IN625. PorscheFanatics confirms the PET identity; FVD publishes only the envelope and mass of the left-hand cover 993 123 113 51.

classification.intended_use: CAD, thermal, mechanical and DfAM screening; no manufacturing for fitment and no vehicle installation authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, PET illustration or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - PET transcription of the 993 Turbo groups
sources.notes: Confirms 993 123 113 51 in turbo group 202-16, with no dimension and no CAD surface. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TURBO-PET.

sources.title: FVD - left heat shield cover 99312311351
sources.notes: FVD declares 160 x 110 x 105 mm, 0.23 kg and the 993 Turbo/GT2 applications. The F0 topology and interfaces are independent. See SRC-FVD-993-TURBO-HEAT-SHIELD-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 material data sheet
sources.notes: M 290 40 µm screening values, dependent on orientation and post-processing. See SRC-EOS-IN625-MATERIAL-DATA.

sources.title: Special Metals - INCONEL alloy 625
sources.notes: Wrought thermal properties used as references, never as an LPBF allowables map. See SRC-SPECIAL-METALS-INCONEL-625.

material.grade: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 / UNS N06625, screening; OEM material unknown
material.standard: ASTM F3055, AMS 7000 or AMS 7001 to be contracted according to the selected process

post_processing: support removal with full opening of the shell
stress relief qualified for the machine and parameters
removal from the build plate and controlled straightening of the thin wall
machining or boring of the interfaces after adding machining allowances
thermal coating to be decided after testing
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling
demonstrated capability on a 0.8 mm wall and representative coupons
dimensional inspection of the envelope, edges and interfaces
CT or radiography of the bosses and penetrant testing after finishing
roughness, porosity, residual stresses and distortion specified by contract
thermal, vibration and cyclic tests before fitment

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Galvanic compatibility of IN625 with OEM fasteners and brackets to be defined after identification of the real materials.

known_limits: Only the 160 x 110 x 105 mm envelope comes from FVD; profile, wall, bosses and holes are hypothetical.
The F0 mass of 325.58 g exceeds the published 230 g by 41.6%; the commercial material is unknown and no validation by mass is possible.
The temperatures, emissivity, view factor, force and support conditions are synthetic.
The calculation ignores convection, real turbo geometry, shell curvature, contact, vibration, thermal fatigue, oxidation and creep.
The STEP proves only a computable BREP within the envelope and must not be manufactured for fitment.
